title: BeamNG permadeath rule hard crash or permanent injury ends the run
content:
Their self-imposed BeamNG career permadeath rule: if the car crashes hard enough, or accumulates enough permanent injuries/damage, the run is over (delete the profile and start fresh). Not an in-game mode — their own house rule. They may ask me to judge whether a wreck qualifies from damage data.
